# A blossom tree (generated by make_env.py), 2.6 m tall.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.455 0.337 0.608 --no-slot
material new Bloom --base-color 1.0 0.702 0.796 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 1.4 --location 0 0 0.7
material assign Bark
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.75 --location 0 0 1.75
material assign Bloom
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location -0.45 0.1 1.45
material assign Bloom
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.52 --location 0.45 -0.1 1.5
material assign Bloom
select all
shade flat
export tree.glb
